title: How a Florida man’s private AI conversations led to an FBI investigation
summary_full: A former analyst from Goldman Sachs faces repercussions after admitting to using ChatGPT to threaten his ex-girlfriend. He pleaded guilty to charges of stalking and making written threats to kill. OpenAI intervened by notifying federal officials upon recognizing alarming dialogue. Zhou has been sentenced to eight years of probation along with electronic monitoring, shedding light on the implications of AI in criminal cases and raising concerns regarding user privacy.
